note:
Latch v7 fit-test coupons (14 Nov, Spark: one plate to test every fit before printing the real cartridges and receivers).
Each coupon is cut out of the real geometry (make.py's build(), standin.py's stand-in), keeps the real part's print orientation (each
parent's own pose from make.printability, the receiver's mount plane down as the engine part prints), is cropped to the fit, and stands on a
3 mm tab with its number engraved. One A1 mini plate (PCTG), plus the TPU seat strip as its own file. Nothing here changes make.py or a setup.
tpu: print/latch7_coupon_strip_tpu.stl (TPU 95A, the real seat strip, +y face down), solid check PASS

coupons.name: Scout plug carrier: the XT60W-M pocket
coupons.goes_in: the XT60W-M (male) in its collar (coupon collar), seated as on the drone
coupons.good: the collar drops in by hand with no play you can feel, the plug's face flush with the pocket's mouth; carrier: the cap lies flat over it with no rocking
coupons.tight_or_loose: latch5 battery_latch_v4.P_CLR (0.15 a side on the plug's pockets) and the XM_* plug numbers (Spark's measurement first)
coupons.pose: as its part: the +y face of the part toward the bed

coupons.name: Scout plug cap: the XT60W-M pocket
coupons.goes_in: the XT60W-M (male) in its collar (coupon collar), seated as on the drone
coupons.good: the collar drops in by hand with no play you can feel, the plug's face flush with the pocket's mouth; cap: the cap lies flat over it with no rocking
coupons.tight_or_loose: latch5 battery_latch_v4.P_CLR (0.15 a side on the plug's pockets) and the XM_* plug numbers (Spark's measurement first)
coupons.pose: as its part: the +y face of the part toward the bed

coupons.name: Scout cartridge lead end: the XT60W-F pocket and its two set screws
coupons.goes_in: the pack's XT60W-F (female), its D-key to the chamfered corners; two M3 x 8 set screws from the end
coupons.good: the plug slides in with finger force and the key only goes one way; the set screws cut their own thread in the o 2.5 holes and pinch the plug's back without cracking the boss
coupons.tight_or_loose: latch5 battery_latch_v4.P_CLR and XF_W / XF_D / XF_KEY (the XT60W-F body); the set screw holes' o 2.5 (cyl r 1.25 in cartridge())
coupons.pose: as its part: the -y face of the part toward the bed

coupons.name: Scout cartridge latch half: the bolt's wall hole, channel, rib and stop bar notch
coupons.goes_in: the Scout bolt (coupon 4) from outside through the wall hole; the stop bar (coupon stop bar) dropped across the rib into the bolt's top
coupons.good: the bolt slides its full 4.9 to the rib under its own weight when tilted, no catch; with the stop bar in, it stops at rest with 3.0 standing out of the wall
coupons.tight_or_loose: make.py bl.CH_CLR (0.35, the wall hole round the bolt) and ST (the stop bar's 0.25 clearances in slider() and centre_rib())
coupons.pose: as its part: the -y face of the part toward the bed

coupons.name: Scout bolt (the real one): its spring slots and its magnet pocket
coupons.goes_in: two PATIKIL 0.3 x 3.0 x 30 springs, each on a printed o 2.0 x 7 guide pin (coupon 'pin'), in the two slots; a o 2 x 2 N52 magnet in the underside pocket
coupons.good: a spring with its pin drops into its slot and lies below the bolt's top face; the magnet presses in with a thumb and stays when the bolt is shaken
coupons.tight_or_loose: slots: make.py bl.SPR_R (1.6) and SPR_Y; magnet: bl.MAG_D (2.0) and bl.MAG_DEPTH (2.2)
coupons.pose: as its part: the +x face of the part toward the bed

coupons.name: Scout receiver hold-down notch
coupons.goes_in: the 3 x 3 steel square key (the funnel's end-wall tongue), flats up and down, slid into the notch from its open end
coupons.good: the key slides in by hand along the notch with no up-and-down play you can feel, and does not need pushing
coupons.tight_or_loose: make.py HOLD (y 6.0..10.0 is the notch's 4.0 height round the 3.0 key; depth 2.5)
coupons.pose: as its part: the +y face of the part toward the bed

coupons.name: Overseer receiver deck boss: M3 x 10 from below into the base's insert
coupons.goes_in: an M3 x 10 socket head cap screw from below: through the o 3.4 hole, its head in the counterbore
coupons.good: the screw drops through the hole free; the head sits flat on its bearing face below the deck, not proud
coupons.tight_or_loose: make.py DRONE_HEAD (r 3.2 counterbore, h 2.8) and bl.BOLT_D (3.4)
coupons.pose: as its part: the +y face of the part toward the bed

coupons.name: Overseer plug cap: an M3 x 5.7 heat-set insert hole
coupons.goes_in: an M3 x 5.7 brass heat-set insert, pressed in with the iron at PCTG temperature; then an M3 screw from below
coupons.good: the insert goes in square and flush, the plastic rolls a small collar, the screw turns in without the insert spinning
coupons.tight_or_loose: make.py build(): the cap's o 4.0 hole (cyl r 2.0) over the lead-end bolts
coupons.pose: as its part: the +y face of the part toward the bed

coupons.name: Scout receiver seat strip groove and its keys
coupons.goes_in: the TPU 95A seat strip (latch7_coupon_strip_tpu.stl, the real strip), pressed into the recess between its two keys
coupons.good: the strip presses in and stays when the coupon is turned over; it stands 1.5 proud of the deck
coupons.tight_or_loose: latch5 battery_latch_v4.STRIP_T (2.4), STRIP_REC (0.9) and make.py SEAT_HZ / SEAT_KEY (0.2 clear of the strip's ends)
coupons.pose: as its part: the +y face of the part toward the bed

coupons.name: Scout stand-in cartridge latch half: the spring's post, rod and slot (Spark's 5.0 x 0.5 x 25)
coupons.goes_in: one of Spark's springs over the rod to the post, then the stand-in bolt (coupon 17) from outside, its block's channel over the spring's free end
coupons.good: the spring slides on the rod free; pushed in by hand the bolt comes back out to the wall smartly and does not rub
coupons.tight_or_loose: standin.py ROD_R (1.75 for the spring's 4.0 ID), POCKET_R (2.7 for its 5.0 OD), TOP (6.4)
coupons.pose: as its part: the -y face of the part toward the bed

coupons.name: Scout stand-in bolt: the spring block
coupons.goes_in: the spring's end into the block's channel
coupons.good: the spring's end sits square on the seat inside the channel
coupons.tight_or_loose: standin.py POCKET_R, DEPTH (3.3)
coupons.pose: as its part: the +y face of the part toward the bed

coupons.name: stop bar (the real one, both packs)
coupons.goes_in: across the rib's notch into both bolts' tops (coupons 'latch half')
coupons.good: drops in under its own weight; the bolts stop on its T ends
coupons.tight_or_loose: make.py ST
coupons.pose: as its part: the +y face of the part toward the bed

coupons.name: guide pin o 2.0 x 7 (the real one) for the PATIKIL spring

coupons.name: XT60W-M plug collar (the real one, both packs)
coupons.goes_in: the XT60W-M, glued after the fit is right
coupons.good: the plug pushes in with no side play; WAITING on Spark's measurement of the plug body
